title: Musical talents in the family and the first combination
summary: The brothers play piano and violin; the first combination was piano, violin and drums.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: How many of your family are musical themselves? Well, we all play the instruments a little bit. Two brothers played the piano and two played the violin. Which two played the piano? Joe and John, and Roy and I played the violin. I see. So you know how to listen carefully to the music and judge the talent. Oh, we like music, yes. Who was playing with Charlie Mills? Do you remember the other two songs? The first name I don't know. That was the combination of piano, violin and drums. That was the first combination. And later on, of course, went to the larger one.
And then, I was a band of drums.
How long was Melton on the band?
